ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - winPEAS Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: WinPEAS is a script that search for possible paths to escalate privileges on Windows hosts. The checks are explained on book.hacktricks.xyz

sequences.query: ((process_original_file_name = "winPEAS\.exe" OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\winPEASany\\_ofs\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winPEASany\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winPEASx64\\_ofs\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winPEASx64\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winPEASx86\\_ofs\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\winPEASx86\\\.exe$"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ applicationsinfo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ browserinfo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ eventsinfo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ fileanalysis.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ filesinfo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ processinfo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ servicesinfo.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ windowscreds.*")) OR process_command_line = RGX(".*https\\:\\/\\/github\\\.com\\/carlospolop\\/PEASS\\-ng\\/releases\\/latest\\/download\\/.*") OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\-linpeas$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\ \\-linpeas$")))
